about: ADR-0059 Decision 10, items 1 to 3 and 8: each text or operation directory a persona region makes, the blocks that read it, and every path through the command, with the releasing step (release) or the reason it is kept (keep). tests/plugin-shape/test-runbook-cli-contracts.mjs holds the rendered regions to this list both ways (tmpdirProblems in tests/_runbook-checks.mjs). A block is named by a pattern of its text; a directory by the variable the releasing block gives the release. optional_consumers: consumers some runbooks lack (an authored block of one persona). instead_of: blocks that run in place of the releasing block, on another path of the command, never after it. guard: the if condition an end release runs under, when it has one. at: end (on the block's success path, after its last exit and its last other use of the variable), exit (on each of the block's exits, from its EXIT trap), exit-failed (on its failing exits only). authored: each persona file whose authored text (its region bodies aside) tells the agent to make a directory, and the step that releases it (region:<id>, a region the file renders, or the authored sentence); held both ways by the same test file.
